schema_version.description: Schema version. Higher versions are loaded with a warning.

note_links.description: Links shown beside a note id on the card, in this order. Leave out a key to hide that link.

vault.description: Obsidian vault name (as Obsidian lists it).

folder.description: Notes folder inside the vault, e.g. vault/wiki.
Absolute host path of the notes folder — no ~ (the card runs in the door container, whose ~ is not yours).

editor.description: Editor URL scheme that opens the file: vscode, cursor, zed (Slack does not link file://).

llm.description: LLM connection + bootstrap policy (v2). The engine is OpenAI-compatible and backend-agnostic; `provider` steers only the host-side bootstrap (model pull / daemon ensure / health probe). Runtime env (BORING_LLM_*) still overrides.

provider.description: ollama = ensure serve + pull models. lmstudio = OpenAI /v1, models loaded via its UI/`lms` (no pull). openai-compatible = vLLM/llama.cpp/remote OpenAI (no pull).

base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL. LM Studio is usually http://localhost:1234/v1.

model.description: Chat/synthesis model — used only by the ask/brief generation path.

embed_model.description: Embedding model — the only model drudge itself calls (kernel A). Authoritative when set.

embed_dim.description: Embedding dimension. MUST match embed_model's output (bge-m3=1024, nomic-embed-text=768, OpenAI 3-small=1536). Changing it needs `make reset` (vectors are reshaped).

api_key_env.description: Name of the env var holding the API key (providers that need auth). The key itself never lives in boring.json.

bootstrap.description: auto = bootstrap may start a daemon / pull models. manual = health-check only, never serve/pull (user owns the server, e.g. LM Studio).

embed_model.description: DEPRECATED (v1) — use llm.embed_model. Still honored as a fallback when llm.embed_model is unset.

embed_dim.description: DEPRECATED (v1) — use llm.embed_dim. Still honored as a fallback when llm.embed_dim is unset.

checkout_roots.description: Directories (~ expanded, depth ≤ 3) holding your git checkouts. The nightly hygiene pass reports projects named after a checkout folder instead of its remote repo. Unset = the check is not run (reported as not scanned, never as zero).

allow_company_origin.description: When true, origin:company notes (session experience from company work) are accepted corpus and do not flip the audit 'clean' flag. Default false flags them for review and also leaves them out of the decisions, risks, next_actions and stalled registers. Governs session experience only — company KB originals stay off-policy.

match.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against git remote URL first, then cwd.

code_index.description: Explicit source-code corpus. This is separate from repos, which classifies memory origin.

schedule.description: How often the scheduled work runs. An env variable of the same job (named in each description) takes over from this file.

compact_hours.description: Database compact period (rides the next sync tick). Env BORING_COMPACT_HOURS.

brief_hour.description: Local hour of the daily brief; null = off. Env BORING_BRIEF_HOUR (the engine's compose line BORING_ENGINE_BRIEF_HOUR; `off` = off).

ingest_tick_minutes.description: Period of the session-ingest tick (the hermes memory-ingest-worker job and the host codex-ingest job). Applied when `agent_wiring --install` runs.

queue_per_tick.description: Sessions distilled per ingest tick. Env BORING_QUEUE_PER_TICK.

vector.description: Vector index backend of the Rust engine.

backend.description: pgvector or surreal. surreal reads vectors from the SurrealDB in `surreal`, frozen at the last `vector-fill`; recurrences stays on pgvector. Any other value does not stop the engine: it runs on pgvector and config_get / the startup log say so.

surreal.description: SurrealDB connection, used when backend is surreal and by `vector-fill`. Env BORING_SURREAL_URL takes over `url`.

password_env.description: Name of the env variable holding the password; the password itself never goes in this file.

collect.description: Which past sessions the collectors pick up. An env variable of the same value (named in each description) takes over from this file.

window_hours.description: Ignore sessions older than this. Env COLLECT_WINDOW_HOURS.

min_bytes.description: Skip sessions smaller than this. Env COLLECT_MIN_KB (in KB).

stable_age_seconds.description: A transcript modified more recently than this is still open and is left alone. Env COLLECT_STABLE_AGE_SECONDS.

pending_ttl_seconds.description: How long a pending marker holds a session. Env COLLECT_PENDING_TTL / INGEST_PENDING_TTL.

retry_ttl_seconds.description: How long a retry marker holds a session. When omitted, it follows pending_ttl_seconds (no default of its own). Env COLLECT_RETRY_TTL / INGEST_RETRY_TTL.

checkout_roots.description: Directories whose git checkouts the vault hygiene pass compares against project names. ~ is expanded.

hermes_cron_jobs.description: Managed hermes-agent cron jobs keyed by job name. Jobs not listed here are left untouched. An empty object disables managed jobs.

schedule.description: Cron expression (minute hour dom mon dow). Currently only '* *' dom/mon and specific dow are fully supported.

deliver.description: hermes delivery target. Use 'local' for jobs whose script already delivers itself (the card scripts post to Slack through the door) — hermes would only re-wrap the output.

settings_path.description: Optional agent settings file path override (e.g. MCP config or Claude Code settings.json). ~ expansion supported.

adapter.description: How this agent is wired. Inferred when omitted.
